question: Q starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 9 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point B. Towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees.)
solution:
Given:

Q starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the South.

He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 9 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5a43d3dbf4403ed163a945ae2609721728192c3dc2149439525459ae52558ee.png] 

Thus, Q should drive (10 km - 7 km) 3 km in the west direction to reach Point A again.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
